subject: Mobile Development
title: Firefox OS and the Web-Only Dream
description: A 60-second lesson on Firefox OS and the Web-Only Dream.

hook.text: Mozilla wanted a phone OS where every app was just a website. No native code needed.

buildup.text: Firefox OS targeted ultra-low-cost phones in developing markets at $25 per handset.

discovery.text: Web apps couldn't match native performance. Games stuttered. Cameras lagged.

twist.text: Android Go launched and offered real Android on cheap phones, undercutting Firefox OS.

climax.text: Mozilla shut down Firefox OS in 2016. The web-only phone remains a dream deferred.

punchline.text: Web apps still can't fully replace native ones.

quiz.question: What was Firefox OS's core idea?
options: All apps are web apps, no native code
